# Navigation & Design Audit — Artifact Surfaces

> Comprehensive audit of every interactive element across all 7 surfaces of Jolieden's prototype artifact (`/public/suite.html`). 14 specialist agents (7 surfaces × nav + design) ran in 3 rounds, looping until two consecutive rounds found nothing new. Each flag has a concrete proposed fix.

**Scope:** Artifact surfaces only — `client.html`, `kiosk.html`, `stylist.html`, `owner.html`, `manager.html`, `shoot.html`, `site.html` (each surface is base64-encoded into the `SURF` object in `/public/suite.html`).

**Run metadata:** 1492 total findings across 7 surfaces. 63 specialist agents, ~27-minute fan-out.

---

## How to read this report

Each finding has:
- **Severity** — critical (blocks core flow) → high (important action broken) → medium (nav gap / polish) → low (nice-to-have)
- **Source** — `NAV` (functional dead-end / missing nav) or `DESIGN` (visual / hierarchy / copy / brand)
- **Location** — exact screen + element path
- **What breaks** — what the user actually experiences
- **Proposed fix** — concrete implementation guidance (route target, new copy, structural pattern)

Findings are grouped by surface, then sorted by severity. Use Ctrl-F + the severity badge (e.g. `🔴 CRITICAL`) to triage.

---

## Client Companion App  `client`

*Logged-in mobile app: bookings, journey timeline, rewards, profile, AI chat surface. Should support viewing/editing bookings, browsing styles, viewing past services, redeeming rewards.*

**215 findings · 216 fixes**

### 1. No date/time selection step before confirming

**🔴 CRITICAL** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 7 > Confirm flow
- **What breaks:** The wizard collects category, style, size, length, color, add-ons, and preferences but never asks the client what day or time they want. The appointment is confirmed with no scheduling input. This is a missing core step, not a polish issue.
- **Proposed fix:** Insert a new wizard step bk-time between bk-extras and bk-review. UI: date strip (next 14 days as scrollable pills) + stylist-availability time slots underneath. Pre-select the earliest reasonable slot. Required to advance. Store wiz.date and wiz.time.

### 2. AI consultant call has no auth header — will always error in production

**🔴 CRITICAL** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Style Consultant > Loading screen > Results screen (after photo upload or skip)
- **What breaks:** The fetch to api.anthropic.com on line 1420 sends no x-api-key or Authorization header, so the request fails with a 401 every time outside the artifact preview environment. The user clicks 'See my styles' through a long questionnaire and a hopeful loading state ('Choosing your three…'), then lands on the bland error card with no retry button — only 'Start over', which forces them to redo all six questions. The signature consultant flow silently breaks the moment this is decoupled from Claude.ai.
- **Proposed fix:** Route the fetch through a Next.js API route (/api/consult) that holds ANTHROPIC_API_KEY server-side. Add an AbortController with a 25s timeout, retry button on error, and a friendly error card. Show a clear 'Couldn't reach the consultant — try again' state with a 'Try again' primary button (reuses the same answers).

### 3. Back from review reopens add-ons step but Continue button is gone

**🔴 CRITICAL** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Booking wizard step 7 > Back arrow
- **What breaks:** showStep(n) hides the wizNext button when n===7 but does not un-hide it when going back. If the user taps the back arrow from step 7 to step 6, the global Continue button stays display:none — they are stuck on step 6 with no way to re-advance except editing fields that do not auto-advance.
- **Proposed fix:** Fix showStep(n): when n<7, set wizNext display back to '' (or 'block'). Currently only hidden on n===7 but never restored. One-line bug fix in showStep.

### 4. Anthropic API call is browser-direct, exposing API key in production

**🔴 CRITICAL** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Style Consultant > runConsult() > fetch to api.anthropic.com
- **What breaks:** The fetch hits api.anthropic.com from the browser with no proxy. In production any anthropic-version header or key would have to be in client JS — the request as written omits both headers, so it will never work, and a future patch would inevitably expose a key.
- **Proposed fix:** Route through /api/consult Next.js route handler. Server reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from env. Browser fetches /api/consult with just the questionnaire payload. Same fix as flag #34.

### 5. Interactive divs have no role, tabindex, or keyboard handler

**🔴 CRITICAL** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Entire app — onclick handlers on div elements (home loc pill, banners, cards, spotlight, all .opt, .swatch, .pf-link, .sty)
- **What breaks:** Nearly every interaction in the app is an onclick on a div, span, or label with no role='button', no tabindex, no keydown handler, and no aria-pressed for toggles. Screen-reader users hear 'group' or static text; keyboard users can't reach or activate anything.
- **Proposed fix:** Audit and convert: every onclick-div becomes role='button' tabindex='0' with onkeydown handler (Enter/Space → trigger onclick). Toggles add aria-pressed. Carousels add role='region' aria-label. Single utility function makeButton(el) applied at render.

### 6. Browser-direct Anthropic call will fail CORS even before auth fails

**🔴 CRITICAL** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-loading > runConsult fetch to api.anthropic.com
- **What breaks:** The fetch goes straight from the client browser to api.anthropic.com with no Authorization header (#34 noted that) AND from a browser origin Anthropic's API does not allow. Even on a logged-in production account, this call would be blocked by CORS — the error path always fires.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #34 and #142: move to /api/consult Next.js route handler. CORS is no longer a browser concern. Server-side fetch with proper headers.

### 7. Birthday CTA banner is decorative-only

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Birthday banner ('Your birthday is coming')
- **What breaks:** The banner copy explicitly says 'Book your celebration appointment and we will make the day special' but the entire banner has no onclick handler. The user cannot tap it to begin booking a birthday style; they have to manually navigate to Book and start the wizard from scratch.
- **Proposed fix:** Add onclick that calls wizStart(false) then pre-seeds wiz with a 'birthday celebration' tag and jumps to bk-cat. Create a small bk-birthday sub-state that prefills the date picker to a window around Nov 22 and tags the booking as 'Birthday celebration' so the stylist app sees it.
  - *Route target:* Book wizard with birthday flag set

### 8. Featured style cards are dead unless you tap the heart

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Featured styles carousel > Style card body
- **What breaks:** The .style-card wrapper has no onclick. Only the heart icon (which toggles wishlist) is wired. Tapping the photo or the name 'Knotless Box / Honey Ombré Fulani / Boho Locs / Passion Twists' does nothing, so a client cannot start booking that specific style from the home tile.
- **Proposed fix:** Add onclick to .style-card itself that calls startBookingWithStyle(name) which sets wiz.category and wiz.style based on the tile and jumps directly to bk-size (step 3). Stop propagation on the heart so it still toggles wishlist.
  - *Route target:* Book wizard, jumped to step 3 (Size) with style preselected

### 9. Manage appointment only shows a toast — no reschedule/cancel UI

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Upcoming appointment card > 'Manage' button
- **What breaks:** The Manage button on the appointment card just calls showToast('Reschedule locks 48 hours before your appointment'). There is no drawer, no reschedule flow, no cancel flow. Clients have no way to actually manage their booking from the prototype.
- **Proposed fix:** Build a new manage-appointment bottom sheet (manageSheet) with three rows: 'Reschedule' (opens a date/time picker reusing the existing sheet pattern), 'Cancel appointment' (confirms inside the sheet, then updates the appt card to cancelled state), 'Add a guest' (links to group flow). Replace the showToast call in the Manage button onclick with openManage().
  - *Route target:* New manageSheet bottom sheet

### 10. Book takedown shows a toast instead of opening the booking flow

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Care reminder > 'Book takedown' button
- **What breaks:** Clicking 'Book takedown' calls showToast('Takedown added to your next visit') but never opens the booking wizard or pre-fills a takedown service. It claims to have added something that the user cannot see or confirm.
- **Proposed fix:** Replace the toast handler with onclick that calls wizStart(false) and pre-seeds wiz.category='Maintenance', wiz.style='Takedown', then jumps to bk-len (step 4 - length isn't relevant, skip to bk-time). Add a Maintenance category in stylesByCat with Takedown, Edge touch-up, Reshape entries.
  - *Route target:* Book wizard with Takedown preselected

### 11. Group booking has no group-add UI

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Book > Wizard > 'Booking for a group?' path
- **What breaks:** Tapping 'Booking for a group?' adds a small 'Group booking · you can add members after' note but the wizard then proceeds identically to a solo booking. There is no UI to add additional guests, names, or services. The confirmation message references 'share the invite link' that does not exist in the prototype.
- **Proposed fix:** After selecting 'Booking for a group?', insert a new wizard step bk-guests immediately after bk-cat: a list with the booker's own row + an 'Add a guest' button that opens a sheet (name input + service-category chips). Once guests are added, the wizard runs once per guest (or in a stacked-progress UI) and the success message displays a real invite-link with copy button.

### 12. Deposit CTA skips any actual payment surface

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 7 > Confirm and pay 50% deposit
- **What breaks:** The 'Confirm and pay 50% deposit' button jumps straight to the booked confirmation. There is no payment method selection, no Apple Pay sheet, no card confirmation, no shown deposit amount. For a deposit-based booking flow this is the load-bearing step and it is entirely absent.
- **Proposed fix:** Before confirmBooking advances to bk-done, open a new paymentSheet showing: deposit amount (50% of total in $), payment method picker (Visa ending 4242 / Apple Pay), and a 'Pay $X.XX now' primary CTA. On tap, show a 1.2s 'Charging…' state then advance to bk-done. Reuse buildReview's price total.

### 13. No stylist selection step in the booking flow

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 7 > Confirm flow (stylist selection)
- **What breaks:** The wizard never asks which stylist the client wants, and the profile screen's 'Meet our stylists' rows do not start a booking. A client who specifically wants Aminata or Zainab has no path to request them through the booking flow.
- **Proposed fix:** Insert a new wizard step bk-stylist between bk-style and bk-size. UI: 'No preference' tile (first, highlighted as fastest) + a row of stylist tiles (reuse stylist directory avatars) filtered by the chosen category's specialty tag. Selecting drives availability shown in bk-time.

### 14. Results CTA dumps user at booking entry, not the chosen style

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Consultant > cs-results > 'Book one of these'
- **What breaks:** After the AI recommends 3 specific styles, tapping 'Book one of these' calls go('book') which resets the wizard. The user lands back at the category grid with none of the recommended styles preselected. The consultant's work is lost.
- **Proposed fix:** Replace 'Book one of these' (one CTA) with per-card 'Book this look' buttons inside each rec-card. Each calls startBookingWithStyle(rec.name) which preselects category + style and jumps directly to bk-stylist (or bk-size if stylist step doesn't exist yet). Remove the single global CTA.

### 15. Tapping a wishlist card shows a toast instead of opening booking

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Wishlist screen > wcard tap
- **What breaks:** Wishlist cards onclick is showToast('Booking <style>') — they do not actually start the booking wizard with that style preselected. The wishlist is functionally a viewing list with no rebook path.
- **Proposed fix:** Replace the wcard onclick toast with the same startBookingWithStyle(name) used everywhere else. Tapping a wishlist card jumps to the booking wizard with that style preselected at bk-size.
  - *Route target:* Book wizard, step 3 with style preselected

### 16. Wishlist heart toggle de-syncs across carousels until re-render

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Featured styles carousel + Your wishlist carousel (heart icon)
- **What breaks:** Tapping the heart on a Featured style adds it to the wishlist, but the same style card rendered elsewhere on the page (e.g. the wishlist preview row or the Wishlist tab grid) doesn't get its heart state updated — only the tapped element calls classList.add('on'). The empty forEach at line 1010 telegraphs the intent but does nothing. A user saves a style from Featured, then sees the same card unhearted in another carousel and re-taps it, which actually removes it. Trust-breaking on the headline 'save styles you love' feature.
- **Proposed fix:** Make wishlist the source of truth in a single state object. After toggleWish mutates state, call refreshHearts() which queries all .heart[data-style] elements across Featured, Wishlist preview, Wishlist grid, and rec-cards, then sets classList.toggle('on', wishlist.includes(name)). Tag every heart with data-style attribute.

### 17. Primary appointment management is a toast, not a destination

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Upcoming appointment card > 'Manage' button
- **What breaks:** The only path to reschedule or cancel an upcoming appointment is the 'Manage' button, which fires a toast reading 'Reschedule locks 48 hours before your appointment' and does nothing else. There is no actual reschedule, cancel, add-guest, or change-stylist surface anywhere in the app. For a booking-replacement product, the absence of any appointment edit affordance is a hole in the core promise.
- **Proposed fix:** Replace the toast with openManageSheet() (same fix as flag #6). The sheet has Reschedule, Cancel, Add a guest, Change stylist rows. Each opens a sub-sheet or screen using existing patterns.

### 18. Deposit step has no payment surface — pay is implied but invisible

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 7 (review) > 'Confirm and pay 50% deposit' button
- **What breaks:** The CTA says 'Confirm and pay 50% deposit' but tapping it skips straight to the 'You're booked' confirmation. No card selector, no Apple Pay sheet, no amount-charged moment. For a real money transaction this is the most trust-sensitive screen in the entire app, and it currently lies about what just happened. Even as a prototype, the deposit amount ($X.XX) should be visible on the button or in the price box.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #27: open paymentSheet before bk-done. Additionally update the button copy to include the actual amount: 'Confirm and pay $X.XX (50% deposit)' rendered from the current total.
  - *New copy:* "Confirm and pay $X.XX (50% deposit)"

### 19. Stylist directory rows are decorative — no profile, no portfolio

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Profile > 'Meet our stylists' > stylist row tap
- **What breaks:** Tapping any stylist (Aminata D., Zainab O., Awa J., Bintou C.) fires a toast 'Book with [name]' and goes nowhere. The booking wizard never lets the client pick a stylist either. So the entire 'Meet our stylists' section is non-functional — clients can't see Aminata's portfolio, see Zainab's specialties, or even request a specific stylist at booking. For a salon where stylist-as-brand is half the value (Senior Braiding Influencer titling implies it), this is a notable gap.
- **Proposed fix:** Wire each row to go('sub-stylist', slug) — the same stylist-detail screen built for flag #19. Includes portfolio grid, specialties, rating with /5 scale, and 'Book with [name]' CTA that starts the wizard pre-stylist-selected.

### 20. API failure has no retry — only 'Book' or 'Start over'

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-results > Error state (cerr block)
- **What breaks:** When the Claude call fails, renderError() shows a static error message. The only CTAs below are 'Book one of these' (no styles to book) and 'Start over' (re-walks all 6 questions from scratch). There is no 'Try again' button to retry the same request.
- **Proposed fix:** Add 'Try again' as the primary CTA on the cerr block, which re-calls runConsult() with the same cAnswers. Demote 'Start over' to a text link. Add 'Browse styles' as secondary CTA.

### 21. Oopsie form submits without validating issue type or photo

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Profile > Oopsie sheet > 'Submit request' button
- **What breaks:** submitOopsie() runs closeSheet + showToast unconditionally. The 'What is the issue?' chips can all be unselected, and the photo upload (labelled 'required') is never checked before submit. Users can submit a totally empty request and still see the success toast.
- **Proposed fix:** Add validation in submitOopsie: require ≥1 issue type chip selected and ≥1 photo uploaded before closeSheet. Show inline error if not met. Track chip selection in oopsieIssue state (not inline CSS) — see flag #173 fix.

### 22. 'Influencer' as stylist tier reads Instagram, not salon

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 2

- **Location:** Home > Upcoming appointment card > stylist row ('Senior Braiding Influencer') & Profile > Meet our stylists > tier labels
- **What breaks:** Every stylist is labeled 'Master Influencer' / 'Senior Influencer' / 'Stylist' — 'Influencer' is wrong noun for a Black hair salon's craft hierarchy. It cheapens the artisan voice Diessou's brand cultivates (Fraunces serif, 'protective of hair health', 'gentlest takedowns'). 'Braider', 'Stylist', or 'Specialist' fit her system.
- **Proposed fix:** Replace all 'Influencer' titles with Diessou's craft hierarchy. Apply to the appointment card stylist row, Profile directory, spotlight card, and stylist-detail screen. Source from the personas.ts CAST const so it changes in one place.
  - *New copy:* "Master Braider / Senior Braider / Stylist / Specialist"

### 23. Same style shows three different starting prices across surfaces

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 2

- **Location:** Home > Featured styles carousel ($245) vs. Book > Wizard step 2 > style list ($220) vs. Wishlist screen card
- **What breaks:** styleCard() on Home adds +$25 SERVICE_FEE so Knotless Box reads 'Starting at $245'. Book wizard step 2 shows 'Starting at $220' (no fee). Wishlist cards on /wishlist screen show '$300' for Goddess Locs (raw base, no fee). A client who saved Knotless Box at $245, then taps Book, sees $220 — silent $25 drop. Trust hit. Pick one rule for 'Starting at' and apply it everywhere.
- **Proposed fix:** Decide on a single rule: 'Starting at' = base price WITHOUT the $25 service fee, displayed everywhere (Home featured, Wishlist, Book wizard). Move the $25 service fee into an explicit pricebox row in Step 7 review labeled 'Service fee · $25'. Same number on every surface.

### 24. Takedown reminder fires while a fresh install is hours away

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 2

- **Location:** Home > Care reminder card ('Time for a takedown') — visible simultaneously with 'Today · 1:00 PM' upcoming appointment
- **What breaks:** The Upcoming appointment card says today 1:00 PM Knotless Box install. The Care reminder right under it tells Amara it's time to book a takedown 'to preserve the integrity of your natural hair.' Logically Amara is currently wearing braids ready to come out — but in 4 hours she's installing fresh ones. The two cards contradict each other. Care reminder should suppress when an install is imminent OR when the user is already booked for the takedown.
- **Proposed fix:** Gate the care reminder on: no install scheduled in next 7 days AND last install was ≥6 weeks ago AND no takedown already booked. With today's 1:00 PM install booked, the reminder is suppressed. Reactivates 6 weeks after install completes.

### 25. Back arrow from Photos step resets questionnaire to Q1

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 3

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-photos screen > back arrow (top-left)
- **What breaks:** The back arrow on the photos step calls cGo('q') which hard-resets cqIdx=0 inside the handler. Answers persist in cAnswers, but the user is dumped at Question 1 of 6 and has to click Next five times to get back to where they were.
- **Proposed fix:** Fix cGo('q') handler: when arriving from cs-photos, set cqIdx = questions.length - 1 (the last question) so Back lands on Q6, not Q1. Preserve all cAnswers.

### 26. Special requests textarea is never read

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 3

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 6 > Special requests textarea
- **What breaks:** The textarea has no input/change/blur handler. Whatever the client types is silently discarded — it never lands on wiz state and never appears in the Step 7 review, the confirmation screen, or anywhere the stylist could see it. The 'Anything we should know' field is purely decorative.
- **Proposed fix:** Add onchange/oninput handler to the textarea that writes to wiz.specialRequests. Render this value in the Step 7 review pricebox as a 'Notes for your stylist' row. Include in confirmBooking's stored state. Pre-populate from existing wiz.specialRequests on re-entering step 6.

### 27. Re-entering Book mid-wizard silently nukes all progress

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 3

- **Location:** Book screen and nav > 'Book' tab / 'See all' / 'View all' links tapped mid-wizard
- **What breaks:** go('book') always calls resetBook() which forces bk-entry, discarding category, style, size, length, color, addons, and the textarea. If the client is six steps into the wizard and accidentally taps the Book nav icon (or 'See all' on Home), every selection is lost with no warning, no draft, no confirm.
- **Proposed fix:** resetBook should only reset if wiz state is empty OR user confirms via a 'Discard your booking in progress?' bottom sheet. Detect in-progress as wiz.category or wiz.style set. Add a small 'Drafting...' chip on the Book nav tab when mid-flow.

### 28. Points card has no redeem destination

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 3

- **Location:** Journey > pts-card (1,850 points, Gold member, 1,150 to Diamond)
- **What breaks:** The whole loyalty tier card is decorative — there's no 'Redeem points', 'See rewards', or 'View benefits' CTA on it or anywhere else in the app. Brief explicitly calls out 'redeeming rewards' as a flow but there is no path to spend or even browse what points unlock.
- **Proposed fix:** Add a 'Redeem points' primary button on the pts-card and a 'See rewards' secondary link. Both route to a new sub-rewards screen listing redeemable rewards (e.g. '500 pts · $25 off your next visit', '1000 pts · Free deep conditioning', '2000 pts · Free wash & blow').
  - *Route target:* New sub-rewards screen

### 29. Oopsie form collects no data — chips and photo are visual-only, submit fires blind

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 3

- **Location:** Profile > Oopsie sheet > issue-type chips + photo upload + Submit
- **What breaks:** The issue-type chips just swap inline styles; selection is never stored. The photo upload only triggers a toast. submitOopsie() reads neither, then closes the sheet and shows 'Request submitted'. The 'request' contains zero data — type, photos, and any free-text are all dropped on the floor.
- **Proposed fix:** Convert chip selection to JS state (oopsieIssue variable). Convert photo upload to a real input + state (oopsiePhotos array). submitOopsie reads both, validates them, then constructs a real request object {issue, photos, note} and (in production) posts to /api/oopsie. Show a confirmation with request ID.

### 30. $25 service fee silently folded into base prices

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 3

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 7 > pricebox row 'Style · base'
- **What breaks:** SERVICE_FEE=25 is added to every base price (Knotless Box $220 displays as $245) with no row, footnote, or disclosure. The pricebox total reads honest but the line items lie — the client cannot tell what they're paying the fee for.
- **Proposed fix:** Show the service fee as its own row in the Step 7 pricebox: 'Service fee · $25'. Base prices everywhere become the raw base (e.g. Knotless Box $220 not $245). Single canonical base price across surfaces.

### 31. Every timeline card is a fire-and-forget rebook toast

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 3

- **Location:** Journey > Hair timeline > tl-card rows
- **What breaks:** Tapping any historical style on the timeline ('Knotless Box Braids · May 2026', 'Boho Braids · Mar 2026', etc.) only fires showToast('Rebook X'). The journey-as-archive promise of the screen disappears the moment a user wants to revisit a past look in any meaningful way.
- **Proposed fix:** Each tl-card opens a sub-visit screen showing the date, stylist, style, photo (if uploaded by salon), price paid, and notes. From there: 'Rebook this look' (startBookingWithStyle), 'Add photo', 'Share this look'.
  - *Route target:* New sub-visit screen

### 32. Group booking path runs the solo wizard verbatim

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 3

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 1 > 'Group booking · you can add members after' note
- **What breaks:** Tapping 'Booking for a group?' sets a small grey note above the progress bar but the next 7 steps are identical to a solo booking. The success screen then says 'Share the invite link so everyone can add their service', meaning the user just spec'd a service nobody is attached to — group context is decorative until the very end.
- **Proposed fix:** Implement the bk-guests step (flag #24): collect guest count + names + services per guest before the rest of the wizard. The wizard then runs scoped to each guest (stacked tabs) and the bk-done confirmation shows a real invite link with copy/share.

### 33. Membership perk and care reminder never reconcile

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 3

- **Location:** Profile > Circle perks > 'monthly maintenance visit included' vs. Home > Care reminder > 'Book takedown'
- **What breaks:** Profile says the Circle membership includes 'A monthly maintenance visit ... like an edge touch-up or takedown'. The Home care reminder pushes 'Book takedown' as a separate paid action with no acknowledgement that this user already has the takedown bundled into their membership.
- **Proposed fix:** When user has Circle membership and is due for maintenance, the care reminder card reads 'Use your member visit' instead of 'Book takedown'. Tapping starts the booking wizard with the maintenance service pre-applied to the member benefit (no charge).
  - *New copy:* "Your monthly maintenance visit is ready. Use it for a takedown or edge touch-up."

### 34. 'None noted' allergies row provides no path to add/correct allergies before service

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Profile > Hair profile block > 'Allergies: None noted' row
- **What breaks:** If the client has a real allergy (e.g. mineral oil, lanolin), there is no entry point to record it from Profile. The row is purely display, and absence of allergy data is silently treated as 'none' — a real safety concern for the salon.
- **Proposed fix:** Wire the row to open the hair-profile edit sheet (flag #20) scrolled to the Allergies section. Add a 'Tell us about an allergy' link inline. Also display a permanent 'Notify your stylist' affordance on the appointment card for users with allergies recorded.

### 35. AI intro paragraph could contain unescaped markdown or HTML from model output

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-results > intro text (resultIntro)
- **What breaks:** renderResults sets resultIntro via textContent (safe) but resultCards uses innerHTML with r.name, r.category, r.why, r.tags interpolated directly. A malicious or merely backtick-y model response would break layout or inject HTML.
- **Proposed fix:** Replace resultCards.innerHTML with safe DOM construction (createElement + textContent for r.name, r.category, r.why, and each tag). No string interpolation into innerHTML. Apply the same to any other AI-rendered surface.

### 36. Featured style card photo div has no tap target other than the heart

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Home > Featured styles carousel > Style card .ph div
- **What breaks:** styleCard renders the .ph with only the heart having a click handler. Even more critical: there is no onclick on .style-card itself either, so tapping the name, price, or photo body of a featured style does nothing — confirming the dead-end but specifically: the entire card body has no handler at all (event delegation absent).
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #4: add onclick to the .style-card root that calls startBookingWithStyle(name). Stop propagation on the heart so it still toggles wishlist independently.

### 37. Wizard never inspects textarea contents — confirmBooking discards all preferences

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Booking wizard step 6 > Special requests textarea + Inspiration photos
- **What breaks:** confirmBooking() collapses all state into doneMsg without reading the special requests textarea or any uploaded photos. The 'we will remind you before the day' message is generic regardless of what the client asked for.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #88: read wiz.specialRequests from the textarea state into doneMsg and into the appointment record. Render in the confirmation message: 'Your stylist will see your note about [first 60 chars]…'.

### 38. Loading messages cycle but never resolve to error after a timeout

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-loading screen > loading message cycle
- **What breaks:** If the Anthropic fetch hangs (no response), the cycle interval keeps spinning indefinitely. There's no AbortController, no timeout, no 'still working...' escalation. Users are stranded on loading state forever.
- **Proposed fix:** Add AbortController with a 20s timeout. On timeout, abort the fetch and route to the cs-error state with a 'Try again' button (reuses cAnswers). Per flag #34's retry fix.

### 39. Photo 'required' label is text-only; nothing prevents submission without a photo

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Profile > Oopsie sheet > photo upload (required label)
- **What breaks:** The label 'Photos of the problem (required)' is purely visual. submitOopsie has no validation — it closes the sheet and toasts success even when zero photos were attached and zero issue types were selected.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #14/#55: enforce in submitOopsie. Require ≥1 issue type AND ≥1 photo. Block close + show inline error. The 'required' label is now honored.

### 40. Oopsie chips don't track state in JS — only inline style

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Profile > Oopsie sheet > issue-type chip buttons
- **What breaks:** The inline onclick handler on each chip mutates DOM style directly with no underlying variable storing 'selected issue'. submitOopsie has no way to read which chip was selected even if it tried — chip state lives only as inline CSS.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #56/#173: convert to .chip CSS class with .chip.sel. Track selected issue in oopsieIssue state variable. submitOopsie reads from state, not from DOM.

### 41. Wishlist grid heart calls toggleWish without an 'el' arg, breaking the class toggle

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Wishlist > wcard > heart icon
- **What breaks:** renderWishGrid generates heart with onclick=`toggleWish('${s[0]}',${s[1]},'${s[2]}')` — passing only 3 args. toggleWish expects (name,price,grad,el). The el is undefined, so the if(el)el.classList.remove('on') silently skips, and the wishlist heart on the grid doesn't visually update.
- **Proposed fix:** Either pass `this` as the fourth arg, or (preferred) replace per-call el passing with global refreshHearts() that syncs all hearts after each toggle. See flag #35.

### 42. Book CTA in results uses go('book') which resetBook()s — passed-in style is lost

**🟠 HIGH** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-results > Book CTA
- **What breaks:** go('book') calls resetBook() unconditionally, returning the user to bk-entry. There is no parameter passing to deep-link the chosen recommendation. The user just lands at 'What are we creating?' with nothing pre-selected.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #30: each rec-card has its own 'Book this' button calling startBookingWithStyle(rec.name). Removes the lossy global CTA.

### 43. Timeline shows future visits as past history

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Journey > Hair timeline (May 2026 / Mar 2026 / Jan 2026 / Nov 2025)
- **What breaks:** Today is April 14, 2026 (per the project's anchor date) but the timeline's most recent visit is May 2026 (one month in the future) and is labeled 'This was your 14th visit'. The user's past history is dated after the present moment.
- **Proposed fix:** Re-seed the timeline so the most recent visit is anchored to the TODAY constant (April 14, 2026). Most recent: 'Today · today's install'; previous: Feb 2026, Dec 2025, Oct 2025. Centralize date math from TODAY.

### 44. Birthday banner fires 7 months before user's actual birthday

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Home > Birthday banner ('Your birthday is coming') and Profile > About you > Birthday (Nov 22)
- **What breaks:** Profile says Amara's birthday is Nov 22; today is April 14. The 'Your birthday is coming' banner is always-on regardless, so it fires from any date in the year, not the actual proximity window.
- **Proposed fix:** Gate the birthday banner on user.birthday being within 14 days of TODAY. With Amara's Nov 22 birthday and today April 14, the banner suppresses. Activates Nov 8 onwards. For demo, allow a ?birthdaySoon=1 query param to force-show.

### 45. Copy conflict: 'In service now' card while 'on a lunch break' banner

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **What breaks:** When chair is on, appointment tag changes to 'In service now' while the live-banner says 'Zainab is on a lunch break and will be back around 2:38'. The two states (mid-service vs. on break) contradict each other; a user reading the card and banner together can't tell what's actually happening.

Category tiles also rely entirely on a faint Fraunces label over a dark gradient with no semantic differentiator.

### 48. AI response strings injected as innerHTML without sanitization

**🟠 HIGH** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-results > recommendation cards (h3, rcat, rwhy, rtags rendered from API JSON)
- **What breaks:** renderResults uses template literals to drop r.name, r.category, r.why, and each r.tag straight into innerHTML. A model that emits HTML, angle brackets, or stray script-like text gets executed/rendered as markup, breaking layout and (in production) opening an injection surface.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #141: replace innerHTML interpolation with createElement + textContent. Build rec-card with document.createElement('div'), set textContent for r.name, r.category, r.why; create child elements for each r.tag with textContent.

### 116. Empty photo slot label fires file picker but slot ID 'pslot' is on a label without an htmlFor binding

- **Proposed fix:** Add explicit htmlFor on each label (matching the wrapped input's id like 'pslot-1', 'pslot-2', 'pslot-3'). Also add an onclick fallback on the label that programmatically calls input.click() to handle the iOS svg-tap edge case.

### 121. Nav bar Book tab does not display a 'pending booking' indicator when wizard is mid-flow

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Phone > nav bar > 'Book' tab
- **What breaks:** If user starts the wizard, gets to step 4, then taps Home, the wizard state persists silently in `wiz`. Returning to Book triggers resetBook() which wipes the active step but does not reset `wiz` itself — so internal state and visual state diverge. Subsequent flows can carry over old size/length values silently.
- **Proposed fix:** Add a small dot indicator on the Book nav tab when wiz state has any selection but bk-done hasn't fired. Dot clears on confirmation or after the user explicitly discards (flag #89 fix).

### 122. Check-in button shown for an appointment 'Today · 1:00 PM' regardless of current time

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Home > apptCard > 'Check in' button
- **What breaks:** The check-in CTA is always visible and enabled. Boulevard's rule is check-in opens 15-30 min before. Here a client could tap Check In hours early and the kiosk would receive the request out of band.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #71: gate the Check in button on a 30-min pre-appointment window. Disabled outside that window with caption 'Opens 30 min before your appointment'.

### 123. Timeline entries have no way to view photos of past style — only rebook toast

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Journey > timeline > tl-item rows
- **What breaks:** Each tl-card represents a past visit but only shows a gradient swatch with date+style+stylist. Past style photos (which would be the salon's value-add: 'remember when you wore X') are absent; clicking only rebooks. No way to actually see your hair history.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #120: each tl-card opens a sub-visit screen with the salon's photo of that visit (if uploaded), notes, and rebook CTA.
  - *Route target:* New sub-visit screen

### 124. Confirm button has no disabled state during processing — double-tap creates duplicate confirmation

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Booking wizard > step 7 > 'Confirm and pay 50% deposit'
- **What breaks:** confirmBooking() instantly swaps to bk-done with no disable/loading state. A double-tap on the button would call confirmBooking twice; the second call is idempotent in this prototype, but in production it would create two bookings before the screen swap completes.
- **Proposed fix:** On confirmBooking tap, immediately disable the button + show a spinner state + change copy to 'Charging…'. After paymentSheet (flag #27) resolves, advance to bk-done. Re-enable only if user cancels.

### 125. 'See all' link uses <a> with no href — fails keyboard navigation

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Home > Section labels > 'See all' / 'View all' anchor tags
- **What breaks:** The 'See all' / 'View all' links are <a> tags with no href, only onclick. They're not focusable via Tab, breaking keyboard navigation for accessibility-dependent users.
- **Proposed fix:** Change to <button class='link-style'> with onclick. Keyboard-focusable by default. Apply to every 'See all' / 'View all' across the app.

### 126. Loading screen has no Cancel option — user trapped during API call

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `NAV` · round 4

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-loading > 'Reading your answers' loading state
- **What breaks:** If the consult call takes 30+ seconds or hangs, there's no way to abort, no back button, no escape. The wiz-top with back arrow is on cs-q and cs-photos but absent on cs-loading.
- **Proposed fix:** Add the wiz-back arrow on cs-loading. Tap calls cancelConsult() which aborts the fetch + clears the interval + returns to cs-photos with answers intact.

### 127. Memory card date contradicts timeline date

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Journey > Memory card ('1 year ago today / honey ombré Fulani for your birthday')
- **What breaks:** Memory card says 'a year ago today' the user wore honey ombré Fulani for her birthday, but the timeline puts that same style in Nov 2025 (six months ago, not twelve). Profile birthday is Nov 22, which also conflicts with 'a year ago today' since today is April 14.
- **Proposed fix:** Source the memory card from the timeline data. 'X years ago today' computes from the actual past-visit dates. With re-seeded timeline (flag #178), pick the visit closest to one year ago today (April 14, 2025) — if none, hide the memory card.

### 128. Featured style names don't exist in the booking catalog

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Home > Featured styles carousel ('Honey Ombré Fulani', 'Boho Locs')
- **What breaks:** 'Honey Ombré Fulani' and 'Boho Locs' are shown in featured and journey, but neither is a category or sub-style in stylesByCat. If a user tapped 'See all' or tried to find them through Book, they'd never find the exact match.
- **Proposed fix:** Add 'Honey Ombré Fulani' and 'Boho Locs' to stylesByCat under appropriate categories (Braids and Locs). Or rename featured to use catalog-existing styles. Ensure every Home/Wishlist/Memory style maps to a real booking entry.

### 129. Break ends earlier in the day than start of appointment

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Home > Live banner (in-chair, 1:00 PM appointment) > 'will be back around 2:38'
- **What breaks:** The appointment starts at 1:00 PM, but the live banner says the stylist will be back at '2:38' (no AM/PM). If 2:38 is interpreted as the time, it's only 1.5 hours into a 5-7 hour service. The break time isn't anchored to the appointment.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #82: compute break window from appt.time (90 min after start, 30 min long). Always include AM/PM. For 1:00 PM, break is 2:30 PM-3:00 PM.

### 130. User avatar and Employee-of-the-Month avatar share initial and gradient

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Profile > Profile head > Avatar 'A' and Home > Employee of the Month > Aminata D. avatar 'A'
- **What breaks:** Both Amara N. (user) and Aminata D. (spotlight stylist) render as 'A' in identical clay-to-ochre gradient circles, on the same screen. The user can't visually distinguish 'me' from 'the highlighted stylist'.
- **Proposed fix:** User avatar uses warm-clay gradient; stylist spotlight uses gold/champagne gradient (matches Diessou's gold accent for celebration moments). Two distinct gradient families across the app.

### 131. Sheet handle pill is visual only, not draggable or tappable

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** All sheets (acSheet, assistSheet, checkinSheet, oopsieSheet) > sheet-handle pill
- **What breaks:** The grey pill at the top of every bottom sheet matches the iOS/Android convention for 'grab and drag to dismiss', but it has no event handler. Tapping or dragging it does nothing; the only way to close (besides the scrim) is missing entirely on most sheets.
- **Proposed fix:** Wire the .sheet-handle onclick to closeSheet(). Document the convention — handle tap closes. For drag-to-dismiss, implement a touch handler later (or accept tap as the close affordance). Combined with the .sheet-close X (flag #11), users have two dismiss paths.

### 132. Mid-back length adds nothing to duration estimate but waist+ does

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 4 > Length options ('Mid-back (bra strap)')
- **What breaks:** The duration calculator only checks /Waist/ and /Hip|Floor/ — Mid-back adds the +$30 price but zero duration. A bra-strap-length install on Medium Knotless still estimates the same 4-6 hours as Shoulder, which is unrealistic and undersells the appointment block.
- **Proposed fix:** Add /Mid-back/ to the duration calculator with +0.5 hr. Also tier: Shoulder +0, Mid-back +0.5, Waist +1, Hip/Floor +1.5. Estimates now reflect length linearly.

### 133. Visit count and timeline disagree on when 14th visit happened

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Profile > Profile head ('Member since 2023 · 14 visits') and Journey > timeline (May 2026 milestone 'This was your 14th visit')
- **What breaks:** Profile shows 14 visits as of today (April 14, 2026); journey marks the May 2026 entry as 'your 14th visit' — implying the 14th visit hasn't happened yet. So either the profile counter is one too many or the timeline date is wrong.
- **Proposed fix:** Source visit count from the timeline data length. With re-seeded timeline (flag #178), today's visit is the 14th and Profile head shows '14 visits' accurately. The May 2026 entry no longer exists.

### 134. Wishlist promise that stylist sees saved styles has no mechanism

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Wishlist screen ('Your stylist can see these when you book')
- **What breaks:** Copy explicitly tells the user the stylist can see their wishlist when they book, but the booking wizard never references wishlist contents at any step (style picker, special requests, etc.). The promise sits orphaned with no plumbing.
- **Proposed fix:** On Step 7 review pricebox, if wiz.style is in wishlist, render 'Saved style · your stylist sees this'. Also add a 'Send my wishlist to my stylist' toggle in the booking flow. When on, wishlist is visible to Zainab in the stylist app.

### 135. Hair profile values never narrow or sort the featured/recommended styles

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Home > Featured styles section + Profile > Hair profile + Aftercare hero (all hardcoded 'Knotless Box Braids' / 'Type 4C' / 'Tender-headed')
- **What breaks:** Profile records Texture: Type 4C, Length: Shoulder, Scalp: Tender-headed. None of these influence which styles appear in featured, wishlist preview, or care reminder. A tender-headed user sees Micro Knotless ($320) ranked the same as a Jumbo. The profile is data-only with no surface that reads it.
- **Proposed fix:** Pass the user's hair-profile (texture, length, sensitivity, allergies) into the consultant prompt as system context. Also use it to surface a 'Best for your texture' tag on featured/wishlist style cards. Profile is now functional, not decorative.

### 136. Care reminder doesn't know when current style was installed

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Home > Care reminder card > 'Time for a takedown' (with no install date anchor)
- **What breaks:** The card sits on home regardless of timeline state — there's no derivation from 'last install date + N weeks'. After a fresh install (toggling Enter the chair → Leave), the reminder is still showing, treating the user as if they've been wearing a style for 8 weeks.
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #75/#145: gate the reminder on last install date + 6 weeks. After install completes (chair toggle off → state advances), the reminder reactivates 6 weeks later.

### 137. Hair profile and Style Consultant Q3 ('What is your natural hair like') don't read from each other

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Profile > Hair profile block (Texture / Length / Sensitivity / Allergies)
- **What breaks:** Profile already records Texture: Type 4C and Length: Shoulder. The consultant Q3 ('Fine or thin / Medium / Thick or dense / Not sure') asks again with different vocabulary, and Q5 asks length again. Profile data is ignored, forcing redundant input.
- **Proposed fix:** Consultant Q3 and Q5 pre-fill from the user's stored hair profile (texture, length). User can confirm or change. Eliminates redundant input. Same source of truth.

### 138. Color label '1B Natural Black' uses pro-jargon (numeric Kanekalon codes) without a hint

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 5 > swatch grid (16 colors plus 4 combos)
- **What breaks:** Labels like '1B Natural Black', '2 Darkest Brown', '350 Rustic Red' are braiding-hair industry codes. A first-time client who doesn't know Kanekalon numbering sees '350' and has no idea it means a specific shade.
- **Proposed fix:** Add a tap-to-expand 'Color code guide' link above the swatches that opens a sheet explaining Kanekalon numbering. Also show plain-language descriptions under each label ('Darkest, blackest black').

### 139. Two file-upload surfaces both stub to a toast but the Oopsie one is labeled 'required'

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 6 > Inspiration upload + Profile > Oopsie sheet > Photos upload
- **What breaks:** Oopsie's photo upload says '(required)' in the label, but the upload is a fire-and-forget toast and submitOopsie sends regardless. The 'required' label is contradicted by the actual behavior — and the inspiration upload (step 6, also a toast) has no count indicator. Same stub pattern, but with mismatched validation copy.
- **Proposed fix:** Wire both uploads to real file inputs (flag #23). Validate Oopsie photo presence in submitOopsie. Inspiration photos remain optional with a 0/2 counter.

### 140. Swatch label is 9.5px, below WCAG and brand readability

**🟡 MEDIUM** · `DESIGN` · round 4

- **Location:** Book > Wizard step 5 > Natural & Bold swatches (16 dark-on-dark color chips with 9.5px labels)
- **What breaks:** Label text under each color is 9.5px font-size-medium against cream — well below comfortable mobile minimum (12px) and below WCAG AA target sizing. Burgundy/Red/Auburn etc. are visually similar dark-warm tones; tiny labels make discrimination harder for everyone, not just low-vision users.
- **Proposed fix:** Increase label font-size to 12px minimum. Increase swatch grid spacing to prevent crowding. Add the code label on the swatch face (flag #187) so users have two reads of each color.

### 141. Profile avatar in header is not clickable

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Greeting row > Avatar circle ('A')
- **What breaks:** The 46px gradient avatar circle in the top-right of the home greeting looks like the standard 'tap to open profile' affordance every app has, but it has no onclick or href. Tapping it does nothing; users have to find the Profile tab in the bottom nav.
- **Proposed fix:** Wire the home greeting avatar's onclick to go('profile') so the standard tap-avatar-for-profile affordance works. Add role='button', aria-label='Open profile' and tabindex='0'.
  - *Route target:* Profile screen

### 142. Stylist name/avatar on appointment card is not tappable

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Upcoming appointment card > stylist row (Zainab O.)
- **What breaks:** The mini-avatar 'Z' and name 'Zainab O. · Senior Braiding Influencer' look like a profile link but have no onclick. Cannot drill into the stylist's profile or rebook with them.
- **Proposed fix:** Wrap the stylist row in a clickable target that calls openStylistProfile('zainab-o'). Add role='button' and route to a new stylist-detail screen (see fix for stylist directory rows). Stop propagation so Check-in and Manage still work.

### 143. Bell-tap instruction has no bell affordance inside the banner

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Live banner (when in the chair) — 'Tap the bell anytime'
- **What breaks:** The live break banner says 'Tap the bell anytime if you need something' but the banner itself is not clickable and contains no bell. The FAB at right is the bell, but the copy in the banner does not point to it, so users may tap the banner and get no response.
- **Proposed fix:** Update the live banner copy to explicitly point at the FAB location, and also make the banner itself clickable so it opens the assistSheet directly. Add a small bell icon inline with the copy.
  - *New copy:* "Tap the bell at the bottom right anytime you need something — water, restroom, or a check-in."

### 144. Check-in sheet has no Cancel/close button

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Check in sheet > body
- **What breaks:** Same pattern as the others — only scrim dismiss. If the user opens the QR code accidentally, the only documented way out is to tap outside the sheet.
- **Proposed fix:** Add the .sheet-close X to checkinSheet's sheet-h; also add a 'Done' button at the bottom of the sheet content that calls closeSheet() as the primary dismiss.

### 145. Location switcher cycles silently without a real picker

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Location pill ('Harlem, NYC')
- **What breaks:** Tapping the location pill cycles through ['Harlem, NYC','Atlanta','Maryland'] and shows a toast. There is no picker, no list, no confirmation — a user trying to choose a specific location must tap repeatedly until the right one appears.

### 146. Confirmation has no way to view the new appointment

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Book > 'bk-done' confirmation screen
- **What breaks:** The 'You're booked' screen offers 'Back to home' and 'Book another' but not 'See appointment details' or 'Add to calendar'. The only way to verify what was just booked is to navigate back to Home and check the appointment card.
- **Proposed fix:** On bk-done, add a primary 'See appointment details' CTA that calls go('home') and scrolls to the appointment card, plus a secondary 'Add to calendar' button that triggers an .ics download (or toast for prototype). 'Back to home' becomes the tertiary text link.

### 147. VIP toggle is purely cosmetic — does not affect other surfaces

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 1

- **Location:** Profile > VIP early access toggle
- **What breaks:** Toggling VIP off still leaves the 'New styles just dropped — As a VIP you get early access' banner showing on Home. The toggle changes only its own visual state.
- **Proposed fix:** Bind the VIP banner's render in #home to a global isVip state. When toggleVip flips it off, removeChild the VIP banner from Home; when it flips on, re-insert. Also gate the 'New this season' row in Book on isVip.

### 148. Time-of-day greeting is hardcoded, not derived

**⚪ LOW** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > Greet row > 'Good afternoon' eyebrow
- **What breaks:** The eyebrow always reads 'Good afternoon' regardless of when the user opens the app. A morning user sees 'Good afternoon, Amara' — small but a tell that the personalization is shallow. Trivial to wire to new Date().getHours().
- **Proposed fix:** Replace the hardcoded 'Good afternoon' with derive: hours<12 → 'Good morning', 12-17 → 'Good afternoon', else 'Good evening'. Compute once on home render.

### 149. VIP banner has no destination

**⚪ LOW** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > 'New styles just dropped' VIP banner
- **What breaks:** The VIP banner advertising 'early access' to new styles has no onclick. It looks tappable (rounded card, gradient, sits next to the tappable birthday banner) but does nothing. Either link it to a filtered view in Book or make it visually static (no card affordance).
- **Proposed fix:** Same as flag #3: wire onclick to go('book') with the 'New this season' row pinned to the top of bk-cat. Banner is gated on isVip true.
  - *Route target:* Book screen with 'New this season' row pinned

### 150. Part-style chips use inline JS styling that fights the design tokens

**⚪ LOW** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Book wizard > Step 6 > Part style chips ('Middle / Side / Triangle / Zigzag / Stylist choice')
- **What breaks:** The part chips set border, color, and background inline via JS (line 1107 and oopsie types line 1222), making them brittle and impossible to theme. They also lose the standard .btn touch target — once selected, the chip turns solid clay but loses focus/hover states. Same anti-pattern in the Oopsie 'What's the issue?' chips. Refactor into a .chip class with .sel modifier to match the rest of the system.
- **Proposed fix:** Refactor into a .chip CSS class with .chip.sel modifier. Remove all inline borderColor/color/background mutations from pickPart() and oopsie-type handlers. Selection now just toggles a class. Apply across Booking step 6 and Oopsie sheet.

### 151. Demo toggle is shipped UI, not a developer affordance

**⚪ LOW** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Home > 'Enter the chair' toggle button (floating above nav)
- **What breaks:** The 'DEMO Enter the chair' chip floats above the nav on every screen, visible to any real user. It's a state shortcut for stakeholders, not a client feature. In production it leaks demo plumbing into the live app. Strip it before any user-facing build, or gate it behind a query param.
- **Proposed fix:** Gate the chairToggle button behind a ?demo=1 query param check. If absent, do not render the button. Also keep keyboard shortcut (e.g. Shift+C) for stakeholder use. Strip before production build.

### 152. Multi-select question gives no visible affordance for done

**⚪ LOW** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Style Consultant > Question 5 ('What look are you drawn to?')
- **What breaks:** On the look question, users select multiple options (Natural and subtle, Long and dramatic, etc.) but the 'Next' button is the same color and size whether they've picked 0 or 5. The selected count isn't shown anywhere ('2 selected'), so users with decision paralysis can't confirm their choices stuck before moving on. The 'Choose any that apply' note is small and easy to miss.
- **Proposed fix:** Add a 'N selected' chip caption above the Next button on multi-select questions. Make Next ghost-styled when 0 selected, solid clay when ≥1. Optionally show 'Pick up to 3' guidance and disable additional selections beyond 3.

### 153. Tier scale labels can overflow the card on small phones

**⚪ LOW** · `DESIGN` · round 1

- **Location:** Journey > points status bar (Delta-style tier card)
- **What breaks:** The scale labels at lines 996-998 are positioned absolute at left:0% and left:100%, with transform:translateX(-50%). On a 390px viewport the right label ('Diamond 3,001') gets clipped by the card's padding because half of it sits outside the track. Tested at the locked 390px phone width, the rightmost label is partially cut on the right edge.
- **Proposed fix:** Change .pts-scale right label from left:100%; translateX(-50%) to right:0; translateX(0); text-align:right. Same for left label: left:0; translateX(0); text-align:left. Labels now anchor to card edges and never clip.

### 154. Two CTAs run identical handler — choice is illusory

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-photos > 'See my styles' and 'Skip photos and continue'
- **What breaks:** Both buttons call runConsult() with the same payload. Whether the user uploads photos or skips, the same flow fires. The second button creates a fake decision point that does not affect behavior.
- **Proposed fix:** Differentiate the two buttons: 'See my styles' is enabled only when ≥1 photo uploaded (passes photoCount to runConsult); 'Skip photos and continue' is always enabled (passes photoCount=0). runConsult branches its prompt based on photo presence so the recommendations actually differ — model knows whether to weight visual signal.

### 155. Photos step is missing from progress indicator

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Style Consultant > cs-q progress bar
- **What breaks:** The progress bar (#cProg) shows 6 dots for 6 questions. After Q6 the flow advances to cs-photos which is also a required-ish step but is not represented anywhere in the progress indicator — users have no idea another step is coming.
- **Proposed fix:** Add a 7th dot to #cProg representing the photos step. Update cqIdx tracking to advance the dot when moving from Q6 to cs-photos. The dot remains a phase indicator even though it's not a question.

### 156. Oopsie type chips use inline JS styling like the part-style chips

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Profile > Oopsie sheet > issue-type chips
- **What breaks:** Each chip's onclick rewrites borderColor/color/background inline, bypassing the design tokens for the same anti-pattern flagged on the booking part chips. Same hover/focus state issues will appear.
- **Proposed fix:** Same refactor as flag #44: convert oopsie chips to .chip class with .chip.sel modifier. Track selected issue type in an oopsieIssue state variable so submitOopsie can validate it.

### 157. Oopsie sheet does not reset state between opens

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Profile > Oopsie sheet (reopen)
- **What breaks:** openOopsie() just toggles the show class. If a user previously picked an issue type or partially filled fields, the next open shows the stale selection. There is no state reset.
- **Proposed fix:** Add resetOopsieState() at the top of openOopsie(): clears oopsieIssue, removes all chip.sel classes, clears photo previews, blanks the textarea. Sheet now opens fresh every time.

### 158. Circle perks list looks tappable but is not

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Profile > Your membership > Circle card bullet list
- **What breaks:** The four perks bullets ('Priority booking', 'Monthly maintenance visit included', 'Monthly member giveaway', 'Member pricing on add-ons') visually invite exploration but none are interactive. Things like the 'giveaway' or 'maintenance visit' would naturally drill in.
- **Proposed fix:** Either make each perk row tappable (open a small explainer sheet for each — e.g. 'Member giveaway' shows current month's prize and entry status), or visually de-affordance the bullets by removing list-item styling and indenting as paragraph text. Recommended: make tappable with explainer sheet, since 'maintenance visit' and 'giveaway' have real flows behind them.

### 159. Wishlist grid heart toggle does not update its own class

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Wishlist > wcard > heart icon
- **What breaks:** The heart inside .wcard calls toggleWish(name,price,grad) WITHOUT the el argument, so the heart icon never gets removed from the clicked element. The grid re-renders via renderWishGrid() which masks the bug, but the UI flickers as the whole grid is wiped and rebuilt instead of mutating just the tapped node.
- **Proposed fix:** Fix the call signature: pass the el reference: onclick="toggleWish('${s[0]}',${s[1]},'${s[2]}', this)". Better: implement refreshHearts() globally (flag #35) so individual el passing isn't needed — toggleWish always syncs all hearts.

### 160. Read-mode aftercare cards have no interaction or expand/collapse

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Aftercare > Read mode > ac-read cards
- **What breaks:** Watch mode cards open a sheet on tap; Read mode cards just dump all steps inline with no controls. There is no print, save, share, or collapse — inconsistent with the watch mode pattern and impossible to scan when all five guides expand at once.
- **Proposed fix:** Make each ac-read card a collapsible accordion: tap header to expand/collapse steps. Add a Share icon in each card header that opens the system share sheet. Default first card expanded, rest collapsed.

### 161. Aftercare video sheet duplicates the same steps user can read on the screen behind

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Aftercare > video sheet > Steps list
- **What breaks:** openAcVideo() injects the same step list into acSheet that already shows on the Read tab. There is no actual video, transcript link, or distinct affordance — the sheet adds friction without adding info.
- **Proposed fix:** In the video sheet, replace the duplicate step list with a transcript that auto-scrolls with playback (or for prototype, a 'Show transcript' toggle that reveals steps). Keep the player area visually distinct from the read content.

### 162. Birthday row toast fires on every tap including taps on the Locked pill

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Profile > 'About you' birthday row
- **What breaks:** The whole pf-row has the onclick handler, so tapping the 'Locked' pill (which is the affordance that visually represents non-editability) also fires the explanatory toast. There is no separation between informational pill and the row click target.
- **Proposed fix:** Move the onclick from the .pf-row to the .pf-row-body container only, and add stopPropagation to the Locked pill. The Locked pill should not be a tap target; if anything, tapping it should open a dedicated 'Why is this locked?' explainer.

### 163. Footer tagline mentions 'Tap Enter the chair' as a user instruction in shipped UI

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **What breaks:** The block below the phone frame reads as user-facing copy but actually contains developer demo instructions about the toggle button — same category of leaked-demo-affordance as the chairToggle button itself.
- **Proposed fix:** Move all 'Tap Enter the chair' instruction copy out of the in-app footer and into the stage-around-the-phone area (only visible to stakeholders viewing the artifact). Strip from production app. Inside the phone, no demo instructions.

### 164. 'See all' dumps into Book entry instead of a styles index

**⚪ LOW** · `NAV` · round 2

- **Location:** Home > Featured styles carousel > 'See all' link
- **What breaks:** The section-label CTA 'See all' calls go('book') which lands on category cards. There is no curated 'all featured styles' list view, so 'See all' actually means 'go pick a category from scratch' — bait-and-switch.
